title: Route Service Use and the Review Threshold Percent at Anniversary Reviews
content:
**Account Management note — Ship-To Fulfillment Account anniversary reviews of route-level ship-tos.**

> The review threshold percent follows the route service the ship-to actually used: a ship-to holding Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To or Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To with fewer than 6 shipped order lines shipped by route truck within the 12 months before the review date is reviewed at 85 percent; a ship-to holding one of those three route levels with at least 6 and fewer than 12 such route truck shipments is reviewed at 80 percent.

The percent is the percent of the entry gate spend of the level the ship-to holds at which its review threshold is set.

### What is counted

- Each shipped order line entry of the ship-to whose ship method is route truck counts as one route truck shipment; backorder fill entries are not shipped order lines and do not count.
- A line is within the 12 months before the review date when fewer than 12 whole months separate its date from the review date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.
- The level is the level the ship-to holds at the review.

### Ladder

| Level held | Route truck shipments within the 12 months | Review threshold percent under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To or Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 0 to 5 (fewer than 6) | 85 |
| one of those three route levels | 6 to 11 (at least 6, fewer than 12) | 80 |
| one of those three route levels | 12 or more | not set at either percent by this rule |
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To, Corbett Standard Ship-To or Corbett Priority Ship-To | any number | not set at either percent by this rule |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A Corbett Premier Route Ship-To with 5 route truck shipments in the window is reviewed at 85 percent; with 6 it is reviewed at 80 percent.
- A Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To with 11 route truck shipments is reviewed at 80 percent; with 12 neither percentage applies.
- A route truck line dated 12 whole months before the review date is outside the window; one dated 11 whole months and some days before it is inside.
